paragraphs.text: Data centre demand collapses the reserve margin
Okonkwo et al. 2026, Journal of Grid Studies.

Grid operators in the region reported that demand from new data centres rose faster than any other load category last year, and the increase outpaced every scenario the utility had planned against, leaving the reserve margin thinner than at any point in the past decade.
